methodology: Scores are 1-10 per criterion, expressed as 'goodness' in every case (including maintenance_burden, data_risk_exposure, and vendor_lock_in_risk, where 10 = lowest burden/risk). Weighted priority score = sum(criterion_score * weight), weights: strategic_fit 0.15, immediate_roi 0.15, quality_improvement 0.10, security_improvement 0.10, production_reliability 0.10, enterprise_readiness 0.10, commercial_value 0.10, moat_contribution 0.10, implementation_simplicity 0.05, maintenance_burden 0.03, data_risk_exposure 0.01, vendor_lock_in_risk 0.01. Recommendations array is sorted by weighted_priority_score descending, then name ascending. All entries are evidence-derived from static repository inspection only; no installation, configuration, or connection occurred during this audit.

rejected_recommendations.reason: Redundant with ruff/mypy/pip-audit/CodeQL; introduces an unreviewed third-party source-code data-egress path for an enterprise governance/evidence platform serving regulated-industry clients.

rejected_recommendations.name: Renovate
rejected_recommendations.reason: Overlaps Dependabot; conflicts with this repo's strict == version-pinning discipline visible across requirements*.txt.

rejected_recommendations.name: OSSF Scorecard
rejected_recommendations.reason: Designed to signal supply-chain hygiene to external consumers of a public project; not applicable to a private enterprise repo.

rejected_recommendations.name: Mutation testing (mutmut/cosmic-ray)
rejected_recommendations.reason: High CI-time cost on top of an already long critical path the team is actively shrinking; lower priority than closing the browser-E2E coverage gap.

rejected_recommendations.name: Broad/write-capable GitHub MCP
rejected_recommendations.reason: No repository-evidenced task requires Claude Code to write to GitHub directly; PR creation/push already goes through the existing user-approved gh/git flow.

rejected_recommendations.name: Generic/broad filesystem or semantic-code-search MCP
rejected_recommendations.reason: Would duplicate the existing repo-tools grep_code (ripgrep) tool and the built-in Explore agent at this repo's current size; broad indexers also risk including denied paths (.env*, secrets/**) if misconfigured.

rejected_recommendations.name: Production Postgres MCP / any AI-agent access to production Postgres or Redis
rejected_recommendations.reason: Multi-tenant regulated-industry (healthcare, legal, govcon) customer evidence data must never enter an AI model's context; this is outside the audit's authority to approve at any access level, including read-only.

rejected_recommendations.name: Auth0 Management API connector (unscoped, speculative)
rejected_recommendations.reason: No recurring repository-evidenced debugging workflow justifies provisioning now; Auth0 logs contain login metadata for real end users across potentially all client tenants. Deferred, not installed, pending a specific identified need.

rejected_recommendations.name: OneTrust / Archer / Drata / Vanta evidence-import connector
rejected_recommendations.reason: Strategic-positioning conflict with FOUNDER_DIRECTIVE.md's explicit GRC-displacement framing against these named competitors; requires an explicit founder decision, not an engineering-readiness call.

rejected_recommendations.name: Wiz / Palo Alto CSPM importer
rejected_recommendations.reason: Redundant with the first-party AWS Organizations/Config/Security Hub connector, which delivers equivalent cloud-posture evidence without depending on the client already owning a separate CSPM license.
